meta.name: demo-prep
meta.description: Prepare a customer demo or executive walkthrough around an evidenced outcome. Use before show-and-tell to rehearse the journey and prepare a fallback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 彩排客户演示流程,并备好兜底方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果马上要向客户或高管做演示,担心现场出岔子。
copy.tagline_en: Rehearse the customer demo journey and prepare a fallback before showtime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to demo to a customer or exec and want a backup plan.

howto.what: 帮你围绕一个已证实的成果准备客户演示或高管走查:在展示讲解前彩排整个流程,并准备备用方案。它会先读任务上下文契约与方法参考,只按你提供的授权上下文工作。
howto.when: 在展示讲解(show-and-tell)之前、需要彩排流程并准备备用方案时介入。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前已脱敏的数据包和范围,不重新开始设置或提问。

say.text: 帮我准备下周的客户演示,先彩排一遍流程。
say.note: 按方法参考彩排并准备备用方案。

say.text: 这次高管走查围绕哪个成果来讲?帮我理一遍。
say.note: 围绕已证实的成果组织走查。

say.text: 演示里有一步可能失败,帮我准备备用方案。

howto.what_en: Claude prepares a customer demo or executive walkthrough around an evidenced outcome: it rehearses the journey before show-and-tell and prepares a fallback. It first reads the task context contract and method references.
howto.when_en: Triggers before show-and-tell, when you need to rehearse the journey and prepare a fallback. If called by @fde, it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope; no restart of setup or questions.

say_en.text: Help me prep this customer demo — rehearse the journey first.
say_en.note: Rehearses per the method and prepares a fallback.

say_en.text: What outcome is this executive walkthrough built around? Walk me through it.
say_en.note: Organizes the walkthrough around an evidenced outcome.

say_en.text: One step in the demo may fail — help me prepare a fallback.
say_en.note: Adds a fallback for that step.
